scientific_question: Can a separately sourced stronger teacher provide a bounded bootstrap signal that enables Qwen2.5-3B OpenEvo adaptation, while evaluation remains teacher-free?

decision_basis.h1.29_execution: Capability gate passed with 8 qualified self-generated episodes from 2 task identities, but 64 evaluation attempts produced mean valid task_score 0.0 for BASE and SELF-EVOLUTION and paired delta 0.0.
decision_basis.interpretation: Qwen2.5-3B is not incapable of producing WebShop successes on the observed train panel; the negative result is fresh-task transfer failure, not proof that native data are absent.
decision_basis.teacher_trigger: Teacher route is a separately registered fallback/diagnostic after the negative transfer result; it is not a relabeling of H1.29 and does not enter H1.29 denominators.

arms.BASE: frozen Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct with no teacher data and no adapter
arms.TEACHER_BOOTSTRAP: Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct adapted using only the frozen, audited teacher trajectory manifest; teacher is absent during evaluation
arms.PURE_SELF_EVOLUTION_REFERENCE: H1.29 negative result, referenced for decision context only and not rerun in this campaign

teacher_contract.existing_qwen14b_exclusion_reason: The historical artifact is marked training-data oracle only and evaluation_use=false; it is not a ready teacher trajectory manifest for this campaign.

teacher_rollout_audit.raw_after_receipt_note: Per-slot gpu-after snapshots captured a transient common python3 process; a later host-level snapshot showed no compute apps and 2 MiB on all eight UUIDs.
teacher_rollout_audit.wandb: not invoked; local JSON evidence is canonical for this train-only rollout

student_fit.wandb: online initialization failed because no API key was available; offline spool preserved with fallback receipt

matched_evaluation.decision: negative; close H1.31 and do not sweep teacher/bootstrap variants

required_inputs_before_gpu: teacher source and prompt identity are frozen
teacher trajectory manifest has exact task, trace, score, parser and correctness hashes
teacher and student task splits are disjoint from evaluation
student adapter artifact has exact lineage and reload digest
H1.31 matched evaluation manifest is verified
CPU CI, doctor, W&B online probe, and single-card smoke are green
authorized GPU UUID gate is green

metrics.claim_boundary: A positive result supports only a teacher-assisted bootstrap candidate; it does not prove pure self-evolution, GPT generalization, or OpenEvo superiority over SEED.

tracking.offline_fallback: only after exact online initialization/upload failure is saved with spool hash

next_action: Keep H1.31 closed negative; do not sweep. Return to the separately gated H1.30 matched OpenEvo-versus-SEED execution path, still without consuming formal tasks until its final launch receipt is green.
